body: The matched current trace-effect identity supports a predictable-role all-prefix virtual count without iid bath noise. It does not identify a particular bad output or bound general circuit diamond error. Generic fault weight can be large while this task effect is zero. If only the final ideal Clifford Pauli score is required, directly measuringQin is the ordinary comparator. Repeated reads reduce error only for an already classical latch with independently characterized flips, not a coherent analyzer.
